text.title: FreshDrop, express slot button in the app, 1–7 September 2026
text.hypothesis: buyers in Moscow who order weekly need express slots; at least 8% will tap the button
text.element: bottom of the cart: «Express slot: 149 rub»; the same text as the real feature
text.stub: «Express slots are coming in October. Leave an email and we will tell you first.»
text.audience: Moscow app users with 2+ orders in 3 months, half of them, 7 days
text.threshold: build from 5% click-through; drop below 2%; set on 1 September, before launch
text.result: click-through 4.1% overall, Moscow weekly buyers 5.8%; effect on orders not measured
text.decision: build the slot picker; email everyone who clicked when it launches
